properties.description: The CI probe for the --call door (idea 11 of the VS Code field report). It sets a scratch project up with the real installer and `--harness vscode-cli`, puts the real `reflow2` command on PATH, and drives the binary as the installed files tell an agent to: discovery, every runnable `reflow2 read` the instructions file shows, a write with prose on stdin, the refusal shapes (exit 1 and 2), a held design, the export kept current, and the VS Code hooks run as their file says. Runs in CI's full job; fails, never skips, without the binary.
properties.name: test_call_door.py
